description: Total VALUE of inventory on hand, from the cost layers: the cost still in each item's FIFO or average layers, the same value the accounting ledger's Inventory Asset carries. On hand INCLUDES reserved units (still owned); availableValue prices only the available units. Per-warehouse breakdown ranked by value; each warehouse's units are priced at the item's layer unit cost. unreconciledValue is layer value no warehouse row accounts for; unvaluedUnits are units with no cost layer (valued 0). Optionally value a single warehouse via warehouseId; omit to value all. Read-only.

warehouseId.description: Optional warehouse id (GUID) to value one warehouse; omit for all warehouses.
